'''Bob Madison''' or '''Will Madison''' was a Decipherian whose name, anagrammed, is the card title of Imperial Trooper Guard [[Dainsom]].<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas); lists Dainsom as "[Bob/Will] Madison"</ref>
